title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Payments Worksheet: The Catch-Up Amount
content:
**Worksheet rule.** For a catch-up payment on a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the missed statement is the statement of the billing period that the most recent late fee on the account belongs to; its minimum payment due is the missed minimum and its payment due date is the missed due date; an account with no late fee has no missed statement and no catch-up amount is taken. The catch-up coverage is the missed minimum, and the dispute relief is zero. The catch-up amount is the larger of the missed minimum and the catch-up coverage less the dispute relief, plus the returned-payment add-back and the promotional add-on, less the most recent payment credited after the missed due date, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent; the returned-payment add-back and the promotional add-on are taken as zero.

## Order of the calculation

1. The dispute relief is taken off the catch-up coverage.
2. The larger of that result and the missed minimum is kept.
3. The returned-payment add-back and the promotional add-on are added.
4. The most recent payment credited after the missed due date is subtracted.
5. A result below zero is held at zero, and the amount is rounded half up to the cent.

## Quantities and records

| Quantity | Record |
|---|---|
| Most recent late fee and its billing period | the account's late fee entries, the latest by transaction date |
| Missed minimum and missed due date | the statement of that billing period: its minimum payment due and payment due date |
| Most recent payment credited after the missed due date | the account's payments by credited date; a most recent payment credited on or before the missed due date is not one |

## Worked cases (hypothetical account: most recent late fee belongs to the April billing period; April statement minimum USD 55.00, due 28 April)

| Most recent payment | Larger of missed minimum and coverage less relief | Catch-up amount |
|---|---|---|
| USD 20.00 credited 5 May | USD 55.00 | USD 35.00 |
| none since 28 April (latest payment credited 20 April) | USD 55.00 | USD 55.00 |
| USD 80.00 credited 2 May | USD 55.00 | zero, never below zero |
| account with no late fee | — | no catch-up amount is taken |
